scope.name: Golden Lifecycle Certification and Friction Budget
scope.responsibility: Certify the complete TTRPG lifecycle on supported platforms and establish permanent package-size, performance, offline/recovery, step-count, prep/administration, campaign-memory-maintenance, mobile/hybrid parity, async, extension-safety, and external-friction budgets that prevent regression.
exit_criteria: The golden lifecycle from deciding to play through scheduling the next session passes on supported Windows and Android configurations.
Package/media separation, startup, memory, search, large-campaign, sync, reconnect, recovery, mobile/tablet, hybrid, async, and extension-upgrade budgets are enforced.
Representative mandatory prep/administration time and manual campaign-memory maintenance are measured and kept within owner-approved friction budgets.
Every remaining external dependency is intentional, documented, and integrated through a bounded Multiversal workflow rather than accidental app-switching friction.
The certified product demonstrates capability without transferring hidden maintenance work back to players or GMs.

next_action: Await later owner execution for MTLC-14. Resolve existing supported-platform runtime evidence and owner-approved friction budgets before claiming golden lifecycle certification. GPR PCV-03F remains independent.
